policy: Data too large to track in the repository (see AGENTS.md and scripts/nuclear_data_in_git.json) is fetched from its provider and checked against a hash recorded here. Every data URL that a workflow, script or procedure fetches is an entry; scripts/check_external_data.py fails on a fetched URL that is not listed, an entry that nothing fetches, and a hash that the named verifying file does not contain.
